purpose: Separate public research accessibility and citation requirements from permission to redistribute derived production assets.

huscher2025_agb.access: Versioned Zenodo release with archive checksum and explicit CC BY 4.0 metadata.
huscher2025_agb.citation: Huscher, Finlator & Jackiewicz 2025, ApJ 993:16; data DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17635255

jost2025_neutrino_ccsn.access: The article is open under CC BY 4.0, and the OUP issue/article record confirms a Supplementary data entry. The dynamically hosted package could not be retrieved and fingerprinted; neither Crossref nor the arXiv source package contains the yield asset.

boccioli_roberti2026_neutrino_ccsn.access: Versioned Zenodo dataset with README, three yield archives, release fingerprints, and explicit CC BY 4.0 metadata.
boccioli_roberti2026_neutrino_ccsn.citation: Boccioli & Roberti 2026, A&A 709, A201; article DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/202557714; data DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19503168

limongi_chieffi_2018_cds.access: Public machine-readable tables distributed by CDS/VizieR with an associated refereed publication.
limongi_chieffi_2018_cds.citation: Limongi & Chieffi 2018, ApJS 237:13; VizieR catalogue J/ApJS/237/13
limongi_chieffi_2018_cds.service_acknowledgement: Acknowledge the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France.

nugrid_set1ext_mesaonly_fryer12_delay.access: Public Set1ext release recommended by the NuGrid data page for stellar-yield/GCE use.
nugrid_set1ext_mesaonly_fryer12_delay.citation: Ritter et al. 2018, MNRAS 480, 538; data DOI 10.11570/18.0002

doherty2014_sagb.access: Public supplementary tables hosted on the corresponding author's Monash University research page and linked from Lionel Siess's official SAGB model page.
doherty2014_sagb.citation: Doherty et al. 2014, MNRAS 437, 195 and MNRAS 441, 582

stockinger2020_low_mass_ccsn.access: The MPA Garching CCSN archive explicitly permits non-commercial use when the archive page and corresponding publication are cited.

sukhbold2016_ccsn.access: The MPA Garching CCSN archive explicitly permits non-commercial use when the archive page and corresponding publication are cited; publication notification is requested.

limongi2024_transition_fates.access: The IOP article is open under CC BY 4.0 and links its official machine-readable thermal-pulse table.

roberti2024_ultralowz_ccsn.access: The arXiv article/source is explicitly CC BY 4.0 and the publisher supplies official machine-readable evolutionary and explosive-yield tables.
roberti2024_ultralowz_ccsn.citation: Roberti, Limongi & Chieffi 2024, ApJS 270, 28; DOI 10.3847/1538-4365/ad1686; arXiv:2312.02942

heger_woosley2010_popiii.access: The official VizieR J/ApJ/724/341 electronic table and metadata are public. VizieR explicitly permits scientific use with citation of the original authors, publication, and publisher and requests VizieR acknowledgment; commercial and public-redistribution rights depend on the data origin and are not inferred here.

nubase2020_decay_projection_data.access: Public AMDC/IAEA electronic distribution intended as stable reference data for calculations.
nubase2020_decay_projection_data.citation: Kondev et al. 2021, Chinese Physics C 45, 030001
